caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a pistol, oriented horizontally with the handle on the left and the barrels pointing to the right. The handle of the pistol is curved and colored in shades of brown, representing wood grain. The main body and barrels of the pistol are depicted in golden yellow and brass hues, suggesting a metallic composition. There are two barrels, positioned parallel to each other and extending from a rounded section at the end of the main body. The hammer and trigger mechanism are colored in dark gray or black, contrasting with the brass and brown parts. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or decorative elements. The name "ROSE CAMPBELL" appears faintly in small, light gray text to the right of the pistol.
title: Revolver
